label: H.R. 9721
title: Fiscal Sponsorship Transparency Act of 2026

items.snippet: This bill requires certain charitable organizations to report to the Internal Revenue Service (IRS) information related to fiscal sponsorship arrangements.

lobbying.caption: From Senate lobbying disclosures (LD-2). A filing mentions this bill; it does not show what was asked for, which side the client took, or any contact with this member. Reported amounts cover the whole filing, not this bill alone.

caption: This shows who the bill names and who lobbied on it. It does not show who gains or loses, and lobbying can be for or against a bill.

S001199.label: Overlap, not proof of influence.
S001199.caption: Money from this member's itemized individual donors (over $200) whose self-reported employer falls in an industry that also has a client lobbying on this bill. Correlation only; not a quid pro quo. Donors give to campaigns for many reasons, and a lobbying client may have opposed the bill.
